summary: Iteration 17 (frontend-only) verified the FULL ProgressSlider rewrite (gesture-handler + reanimated) and the chat streaming fix on the public preview (375x667). SLIDER - PASS: CDP touch-drag tracked live on every move sample (0%->6->12->18->24->30->36->41->47->53% across 10 samples; second run 0->59%) and committed exactly on release; tap-to-set snapped to 25% and 90%; ZERO 'Cannot update VisionFormModal while rendering ProgressSlider' (or any 'Cannot update ... while rendering') console errors during drag/release/tap. Vision saved at tapped 90% renders card at exactly 90% and PERSISTS across full page reload (@hera_vision AsyncStorage). WEB-ONLY REGRESSION FOUND + FIXED BY TESTER: vertical drags STARTING ON the slider did not scroll the add-vision modal (scrollTop 414->414) because RNGH web delegate defaults the handler view to touch-action:none (node_modules/.../GestureHandlerWebDelegate.js:96) - the activeOffsetX/failOffsetY config only fails the JS gesture but the browser never scrolls. Fix: pass web-only GestureDetector prop touchAction='pan-y' (propagated into handler config, GestureDetector/index.js:21) in vision.tsx. Re-verified after fix: vertical drag on slider scrolls modal (scrollTop 414->269) AND label stays unchanged (pan correctly fails), horizontal drag + tap still work, no console errors. On native devices RNGH composes with ScrollView natively so this was web-preview-only. CHAT - PASS: home manifest input -> auto-send -> AI reply completed and appears as a SAVED bubble with timestamp; follow-up message got a second distinct AI reply; ZERO 'Cannot update HeraProvider while rendering ChatScreen' errors (streamingRef fix at chat.tsx:69,167-173 verified). NAVIGATION - PASS (fresh unauthenticated context, full 20-question walk): Generate My Profile -> generating -> /subscription?from=onboarding email gate -> back arrow (42,66) -> paywall RESUMED ('Unlock Your Full Potential' + live countdown 'Your stories expire in 02:59:53' + 'View My Plan Options' CTA), NO splash restart -> paywall back arrow (aria-label 'Back to questions') -> lands on question 20/20 with prior answers RETAINED -> re-forward via 'Generate My Profile' -> generating -> /subscription email gate again. No dead-end loop. Zero console errors across the whole run.

Navigation loop fix verified live: persistAndNavigate sets setLastOnboardingScreen(25) before router.replace (onboarding.tsx:709-710); AuthGateStep back honors from=onboarding -> router.replace('/onboarding') resuming paywall via module memory (subscription.tsx:573); paywall back arrow setScreen(23) (onboarding.tsx:978-985). Bonus: onboarding component state (answers) survives the /subscription round-trip, so q20 was still filled on return.

RNGH 2.32 web behavior: GestureHandlerWebDelegate.setTouchAction uses gesture config touchAction ?? 'none' (not the view's RN style - style touchAction:'pan-y' does NOT work because RNW puts styles in CSS classes and the delegate reads view.style inline). Must use the GestureDetector touchAction prop. Reference: node_modules/react-native-gesture-handler/lib/module/web/tools/GestureHandlerWebDelegate.js:96, GestureDetector/index.js:21.

Minor (pre-existing, harmless): onboarding.tsx setScreen wrapper calls setLastOnboardingScreen inside the setScreenState updater (566-572) - same anti-pattern family, but it writes an idempotent module var (not another component's setState) so React does not error. Optionally move outside updater.

rca_of_issue: VERIFIED FIXES: (1) 'Cannot update VisionFormModal while rendering ProgressSlider' - root cause was parent onChange inside setDragVal updater; full rewrite to gesture-handler + reanimated shared values eliminated all per-frame React state updates; verified ZERO occurrences across drag/release/tap. NEW ISSUE FOUND + FIXED THIS ITERATION: web-only scroll-over-slider failure - RNGH web delegate forces touch-action:none on the handler view regardless of failOffsetY, so vertical drags starting on the slider were swallowed (no scroll, no slider change). Fixed via GestureDetector touchAction='pan-y' prop (the only supported channel - config, not view style). Verified: scrollTop 414->269 on vertical drag, label unchanged, horizontal drag/tap unaffected.
